goal: Wire the G0/G1 demo substrate: tools-based e2e runs over the mock service, unknown-outcome resolution, execution-receipt production, the G0 skill with a deliberate gap, and the demo image with the workflow tools baked.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Unknown effects resolve on status query (success re-applies once, idempotent thereafter); 6 service tests pass.
The e2e driver seeds the service, mounts the tools via the composition patch, grades the projected service state, and emits an execution receipt with the full digest chain per run.
The G0 skill is tools-based with a deliberate unknown-outcome gap; guard tests assert the gap and the oracle-free wording.
The demo image bakes the workflow-tools plugin and the loader resolves it from the install anchor.
The full gate passes on the branch.

outcome.summary: Demo substrate wired: service with resolution semantics, receipts per run, tools-based G0 skill with a guarded gap, and the demo image — ready for the G0/G1 model runs.

what_worked: The receipt chain falls out of the driver naturally: skill digest as candidate, composition digest from patch+skill, before/after digests from the seeded and graded service state.
The G0 gap (no unknown-outcome guidance) is itself regression-guarded, so the G1 promotion will have a falsifiable target.

calls.name: demo-wiring
calls.purpose: Extend the service with unknown resolution, rewrite the driver for tools and receipts, write the G0 skill, bake the plugin into the demo image.

calls.name: pnpm-check
calls.purpose: Run the full repository verification gate.

evidence.summary: Six service tests including unknown-resolution idempotency, plus the G0 gap guard and updated oracle guards.
Tools-based driver: service seeding, composition patch, service-state grading, execution receipts under .dal/check/e2e-receipts.
dsh-adaptive-loop/dsh:0.1.1-rc.2-demo built; dal-workflow-tools resolves from the dsh install anchor inside the container.
Typecheck, build, 152 tests, capsule checks, policy check, v0 suite, and benchmark suite all passed on improvements/audit-borrows.

notes: Deterministic wiring only; the model runs themselves await explicit approval decisions in the demo round.
